claims: A statewide emergency alert system drill will take place in Texas on Thursday, April 2, 2026.
The statewide emergency alert system drill will take place between 10 a.m. and 12:30 p.m. (CT).
Residents can expect to receive test alerts on mobile phones (Wireless Emergency Alerts).
Residents can expect to receive test alerts on television.
Residents can expect to receive test alerts on radio.
Residents can expect to receive test alerts via outdoor warning sirens.
The emergency alert tests are authorized.
No action is required from the public.
The statewide emergency alert system drill is a coordinated effort involving multiple levels of government.
The statewide emergency alert system drill is led by the Texas Division of Emergency Management (TDEM).
The statewide emergency alert system drill is led by local jurisdictions.
